Name: God Mode 1.6
Author: norsegodloki0411
Description:
The current God Mode mod is not compatible with 1.6 so I made my own. I have never made a mod ever for any game. This mod literally just watches the value of the player's health. If that value is ever less than the player's max health,  it resets it to the max health. So you could be one shot I guess? Assuming the game evaluates death before it fires my mod? Did I mention I do not know what I'm doing? Seems to work but if it crashes your game then I guess let me know?

Hope this helps other people like me who do not want the temptation of the entire Cheats Menu.
